## No-risk rule

- [ ] No known low-risk security or quality finding will be accepted
- [ ] Any finding will be fixed, verified false positive, mitigated, or converted into blocking follow-up

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One focused PR can close this issue
- [ ] Tests or equivalent deterministic checks exist
- [ ] Documentation/runbook updated if operator or contributor behavior changes
- [ ] Rollback path or feature flag documented if behavior changes
